description: This file defines the 'SystemInfo' class, which is a mock implementation of the 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::ISubSystem' interface. It uses Google Mock to set default behaviors for interface methods and manages subsystem information with an internal map and flags.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISubSystem interface, providing simulated behavior for subsystem management and activity status.

methods.name: SystemInfo
methods.description: Constructor that sets up default behaviors for mocked methods using Google Mock, managing subsystem flags and internal state.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the Register method of ISubSystem interface; registers a notification.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the Unregister method; unregisters a notification.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Mocks the BuildTreeHash method; returns a hash string representing the system tree.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Mocks the Set method; sets subsystem information and updates internal flags.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Mocks the Get method; retrieves subsystem information.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Mocks the IsActive method; determines if a subsystem is active based on flags.
